Directory ./botan contains a copy of the Botan library, which has been obtained
from https://github.com/randombit/botan

For licensing information, please refer to the included documentation.

[tag 3.11.1]

Updating:
- cd $topsrcdir/comm
- ../mach vendor -r <tag_name> third_party/botan/moz.yaml
- Review the changes
- Commit the changes

The tag information in this file is automatically updated. The moz.yaml file
is automatically updated. If upstream changes require updating moz.build, that
must be done with a manual step.

The following files were removed from the source distribution:
.github/
.gitignore
.clang-format
src/examples
src/tests

moz.build
botan.mozbuild
botan_configure.py
